description: Image Description: The image features a laptop with a visible Dell logo on the lower bezel of the screen. The laptop's screen displays an orange gradient background. Positioned on the keyboard is a small figurine of an anime-style character. The character has long red hair and is wearing a two-piece outfit consisting of a yellow top and a green skirt. The figurine is standing on a circular transparent base. The keyboard is black with white lettering, and the laptop appears to be in a workspace or home setting
